explanation: Grandson of Abraham and son of Isaac, who plays an important role in Genesis and is one of the patriarchs in Jewish tradition.
Uncle to Jacob and father of Rachel and Leah, two of Jacob's wives.
Laban's younger daughter and Jacob's beloved wife, mother of Joseph and Benjamin.
Laban's older daughter and Jacob's first wife, mother of six of his sons and a daughter.
The time Jacob worked for Laban to be allowed to marry Rachel, but he was tricked into marrying Leah first.
The ceremony where Jacob marries both Leah and later Rachel, after completing his service with Laban.
The work Jacob performs for Laban as payment in order to marry his daughters.
